name: Ginanti Rona
bio: Ginanti Rona (born June 24, 1987), better known as Ginanti Rona Tembang Asri, is an Indonesian film director. Starting as an assistant director on films such as Macabre (Rumah Dara) and The Raid, she later became a director with her debut work titled Midnight Show.

credits.title: Fatima
